t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They told me I should pick the tall hats most of the time except for the red and brown ones.

vb_textbox.text: You should pay attention to the colors of the tall hat mushrooms when picking them. The brown and red mushrooms amount vary from very low to very high. You should also switch between picking the tall and short ones. Make sure your hands are hovering over the buttons since you need quick reactions for this.
